reason: The absolute metre coverage budget (mean <= 0.60 m, worst <= 1.20 m) was measured on the junction crossing band, where public destinations are DISCRETE. Test8 circle/square goals are CONTINUOUS, so the achievable error is set by how finely 8 candidates tile the goal region. Applying the junction budget there measured the discretization, not the candidate model.
must_not: be used to justify relaxing any threshold

measured_at_25_episodes_per_scenario.note: assigned-error under the WRONG gate, before the square double-filtering fix

finding_that_was_real: square scenes applied the generic forward cone ON TOP of the exact opposite-half-plane rule, so a legitimate opposite-side candidate could still be deleted. Fixed separately; it is not what made this gate fail.
